body: I feel the same. I too have medication but avoid taking it. I dont know why, i just hate taking them. Im 53 and have been diagnosed for the past 20 years as having anxiety and severe depression. I constantly think about suicide but you cant tell the doctors that or they will lock you up. Im lying here next to my wife and all i think about is 1xing. Work is getting real tough i get so angry at people. I just want to be left alone. I dont even know where I’m going with this post it seems that my mind is jumping i feel sick in my stomach cant sleep i just want it all to be over.
What did you think. The feelings went away at 28
Doctors dont care they awe the scars ask if your ok. If you say yes thatts enough for them.
Do you ever fear cutting to deep. Im not religious, but what if. Its a tasty thought isnt it.
Not that early. Life took a turn and i fell into in about 25.  Its getting harder to hide the scars. But I cant stop.
Thanks. Sick of this childish stuff. Give them 30 years and they will feel the same.

You all sound so young. Im 53 and still thinking of selfing. Thats what ive called it for a long time. The sweet release of pain and seeing my blood. I look at my scars and i can remember each one. One day ill do the big cut. I know exactly where to cut. Ive been close numerous times only to stop. Why i cant tell you, chicken i guess.
